author: Unity
description:
CYBRLICH Studios' upcoming CYBRLICH and the Death Cult of Labor is a hand-drawn FPS built with Unity, blending cyberpunk, dark fantasy, and punk energy. Peter L. Schmidt (animator and creative director) and Eric Knittel (programmer) share how they channeled their frustrations with corporate culture into a unique shooter with tens of thousands of frames of hand-drawn animation.

Watch to learn how Eric built custom Unity Editor tools to seamlessly integrate and optimize Peter’s artwork so players can enjoy a fluid and fast-paced experience with no loading screens.
